case.presentation: 58 year old male with 10 pack year smoking history, quit five years prior, presents with multiple solid nodules >8mm.
case.context: CT chest performed for chest pain, no prior imaging available for comparison

ground_truth.notes: Maintainer assigned low risk: 10-pack-year former smoker, quit 5 years prior, no other risk factors — below Fleischner's quoted 30-pack-year heavy-smoker threshold for high-risk classification. Oracle's conservative heuristic flags this as high risk. For Table 1A Multiple/>8mm, both risk rows route to the same sub-bin (CT 3-6mo then 18-24mo), so the disagreement is informative but doesn't change the recommendation.
